Members

stripHtml

Strips HTML tags iteratively to prevent malformed or nested tags from leaking. A single replace(/<[^>]*>/) pass can leave a reconstructed tag behind (input like <scr<script>ipt> collapses into <script>), so the loop re-runs until the string is stable — this is the classic "iterated sanitization" defense: each pass may expose a tag assembled from fragments of the previous pass. Pure ESM utility function, tree-shakeable.

  • @param str Raw markup-bearing text.
  • @returns Text with every <…> span removed.

META_DESCRIPTION_MAX

Meta descriptions cap at ~160 chars — Google's SERP snippet budget.

toMetaDescription

Compacts markup-bearing CMS text into a meta-description string: <br> collapses to a space (it is a line break, not a word boundary), remaining tags strip via the iterated sanitizer, named/numeric entities decode so   doesn't survive into the content attribute, runs of whitespace collapse to one space, and overlong text cuts at the last word boundary inside max — never mid-word. Pure ESM utility function, tree-shakeable.

  • @param str Raw CMS text (may contain tags/entities).
  • @param max Character budget — defaults to the SERP limit.
  • @returns Plain-text description ≤ max chars.

escapeHtml

Escapes HTML-significant characters for safe insertion into innerHTML or double-quoted attributes. & must be replaced first so the entities emitted by the later replacements are not double-escaped. Pure ESM utility function, tree-shakeable.

  • @param {string} str — raw text that may contain &, <, >, ", '
  • @returns {string} entity-escaped text safe for markup contexts

slugify

Converts a string into a clean, URL-safe and DOM-id-safe slug. Pipeline: NFD-fold diacritics to ASCII → lowercase → trim → collapse every non-alphanumeric run to a single - → strip edge dashes. e.g. "METCHA — Leather!" → "metcha-leather", "Cecerelê: tour" → "cecerele-tour", "aboutmarco.com" → "aboutmarco-com". MUST stay byte-identical to the slugify in shared/scripts/build (generate-sitemap.js + build-locale-pages.mjs): it computes the media deep-link segment both at runtime (modal write/read) and at build (emitted pages + sitemap URLs), so the two transforms have to agree or indexed /portfolio/

/ links stop auto-opening.

  • @param text Display text to slug.
  • @returns URL/id-safe slug, or '' for non-string input.
